result.topic_en: A short covering note, apparently by Hardy rather than Ramanujan, saying this completes the manuscripts 'Miss S' had, apart from two exceptions, one being two short manuscripts connected with Paper No. 35.
result.transcription:
This completes the MSS Miss S
had, except for
(1) what I mentioned before
(2) two short MSS about
'$\Pi_\nu(x)$, $\varpi_\rho(x)$' — connected with
Paper No 35.
These I thought Miss S had better
study a bit more

GHH[?].
